thread:
Alex: PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9123 — changes routing fallback + kv-cache TTL. This is gated on the RFC (see below). @arch-team can you take a look? staging canary started but CI is flaky. cc @Maya @Sandeep
Maya: on it, will skim the diff now :eyes:
Sandeep: quick Q — any SLO delta when fallback triggers? need numbers for the rollout plan
Alex: good catch. I measured p50/p95 with fallback model: p50 +3ms, p95 +18ms under 95th percentile traffic. I will add a short SLO table to the RFC.
Jen: heads up — staging run is failing intermittently on `tests/integration/cache_routing_test.py::test_kv_ttl` with `AssertionError: expected len 3 but got 2`. Logs: ```python
E   AssertionError: expected len 3 but got 2
.../cache_store.py:142
```
ci-bot: Build #4872 started for commit ae3f4b8 — running unit + integration tests
Alex: thanks, I think that's due to race in test setup. I'll push a fix to stabilize ordering and re-run CI.
ci-bot: Build #4872 — integration tests failed: cache_routing_test.py::test_kv_ttl (flaky)
Alex: pushed commit ae3f4b8 -> 9c1d2f1, added `await store.flush()` in setup and deterministic seed. Re-triggering CI.
ci-bot: Build #4875 queued (re-run requested by Alex)
deploy-bot: Staging deploy failed: worker-3 OOM while warming KV cache. Error: `RuntimeError: worker OOM at 10.2 GiB` — rollbacks initiated
Maya: OOM is worrying. Is this new with the TTL change or unrelated?
Alex: TTL change itself shouldn't grow memory; suspect a misconfigured mem-limit on the canary worker. I'll check the canary config and bump limit for staging to match prod specs temporarily.
Sandeep: also consider adding a soft-limit + eviction to avoid full OOM in canary. if we add that, we need to document behavior in the RFC (how fallback interacts with eviction).
Alex: yes — I'll update RFC with eviction section and SLO notes. planning: hold merge until arch ack + CI green. Proposed canary window: 30m, 10% traffic, automatic rollback on error rate >1% or p95 latency regression >20%
arch-team: quick note — we need one paragraph in the RFC about failure modes (OOM, eviction, degraded quality) and the rollback policy. Also want the SLO delta table you mentioned. After that, :+1: from arch for merge gating.
Jen: once CI is green and arch acked, I can run a focused staging smoke test (KV correctness + eviction) and sign off for deploy window
Alex: thanks — I'll make the RFC additions, fix the staging mem-limit, and ping when CI passes. Holding merge until arch ack and staged smoke test :handshake:
